name: post_invoices_invoice_finalize
description: Stripe automatically finalizes drafts before sending and attempting payment on invoices; however, if you'd like to finalize a draft invoice manually, you can do so using this method — pending invoice items for the customer are attached and invoice totals are computed. (POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/finalize)

invoice.description: The identifier of the invoice to finalize.

auto_advance.description: Controls whether Stripe performs automatic collection of the invoice. If false, the invoice's state doesn't automatically advance without an explicit action.
